responsibility: Implements SSA-based conditional constant propagation and several closely related propagation-driven simplification passes on GIMPLE. The file defines the CCP lattice and visit logic built on the generic tree-ssa-propagate engine to infer constants and executable edges, substitutes and folds the resulting values, and also hosts companion passes such as builtin folding and post-IPA warnings that walk GIMPLE to simplify known library/internal calls or issue diagnostics after interprocedural propagation.
same_name_distinction: This source file contains the actual SSA conditional constant propagation pass and related propagation-driven passes, defining the lattice, statement/PHI visiting, substitution/folding, and builtin/post-IPA warning passes. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-ccp.h, which only declares low-level abstract bit-value transfer helpers, this file implements the optimization passes themselves.
